mapper.sql: pp.id, pp.pet_id, pp.publisher_id, pp.post_type, pp.title, pp.description, pp.care_type, pp.care_start_time, pp.care_end_time, pp.status, pp.reserved_application_id, pp.converted_to_post_id, pp.reject_reason, pp.verified_at, pp.completed_at, pp.version, p.species, p.geo_hash, p.city, p.district
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_posts (pet_id, publisher_id, post_type, title, description, status, verified_at) VALUES (#{petId}, #{publisherId}, #{postType}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{verifiedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pet_posts pp LEFT JOIN pets p ON pp.pet_id = p.id WHERE pp.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM pet_posts pp LEFT JOIN pets p ON pp.pet_id = p.id WHERE pp.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF pp
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_posts SET status = 'RESERVED', reserved_application_id = #{applicationId}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE pet_posts SET status = 'OPEN', reserved_application_id = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE pet_posts SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE pet_posts SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE pet_posts SET status = 'CLOSED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'RESERVED')
UPDATE pet_posts SET status = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'RESERVED')
